title: Meta shakes up the frontiers, open and closed
author: Nathan Lambert
summary: This has been a week where the balance of American open-weight models took a step change back toward the frontier. Meta took the lead of this charge with Muse Spark Open , which is now the strongest American-made open model by quite some margin, but the addition of Reflection’s first model Beam is also relevant.
takeaways: The inference providers are rapidly scaling, the open post-training economy is forming, and countless enterprises are looking to own their intelligence.
When Meta released Muse Glimmer , the 30B agentic model, Alex Wang said that they were preparing to release the Muse Spark 1.2 model as open weights, which fits with the above.
Riding off a rapid increase in performance of Chinese models, the open ecosystem has been living through an acceleration in demand.
